name: Aero Win Technology Corporation
summary: Aero Win Technology Corporation, established in 1974 and headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan, specializes in producing a wide array of components for the global aerospace sector. The company's product line includes assemblies made from super alloy sheet metal and machined parts, such as oil collectors, plenum air inlets, various front and rear flanges, oil cover inlets, SAGB casings, and bearing supports. They also fabricate formed super alloy sheet metal components like cooling inserts for vanes, brackets, and combustion liners. Furthermore, Aero Win Technology offers precision-machined forged super alloy parts, which encompass combustion chamber liners, inner and outer rings for stators, stator flanges, curvic ring assemblies, inlet housings, and diffuser cases.
